slides.sub: Metalheadz had the club. Moving Shadow had the room.
Before drum and bass had a name, the label was already there.

text: Jungle did not yet have a name.
slides.sub: The genre did not exist. The music did.

text: Rob Haigh was a Virgin Megastore manager.
He came from post-punk. From industrial noise.
Atmospheric drum and bass — before the name existed.
slides.sub: Omni Trio brought melody into a genre that hadn't asked for it yet.

text: He wanted to appear in a documentary.
Playford brought him into the studio instead.
The first drum and bass song that made people cry.
slides.sub: Playford's name was never on the cover. His hands were on every dial.

slides.note: Timeless. 1995. 21 minutes, one track. Goldie's name on the cover. Playford's hands on every dial.

text: Omni Trio. Foul Play. E-Z Rollers.
slides.sub: No farewell. The shadow just stopped moving.

text: The label never needed your attention.
slides.cta: Save this. You'll need it again.
